whenToUse: There's a clear default action with a few variations.
Space is tight, as at the end of a toolbar or form.
Most people use only the default action.
whenNotToUse: The actions differ in kind (keep separate buttons).
There's no default action (use a dropdown menu).

alternatives.name: Dropdown Menu
alternatives.reason: Just a menu with no default action.

accessibility: Each button has its own name, and the arrow button has aria-haspopup="menu" and aria-expanded.
The menu is role="menu"; ↑/↓ move and Enter runs.
Closing with Esc or Tab returns focus to the arrow button.
